verdict.rationale: Clerk's first-party docs describe webhooks that send event notifications, such as user created or updated, to a receiving endpoint (clerk-docs-5). Billing also emits webhook events (clerk-docs-25). The official CLI can relay webhook deliveries to a local handler and verify their signatures offline (clerk-docs-38), which supports agent and developer workflows. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog, details on endpoint registration and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
